lines.zh: 我一路走过去，草都枯了。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass withers.
This belly drags on the ground.
I shuffle toward anything alive.

lines.zh: 每走一步，土里就渗出褐色。
lines.en: Each step and brown seeps from the soil.
Hunger pushes me along.
I close in slowly. No alarm.
Roots on my feet sank into the soil.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，什么都长不出来。
lines.en: Nothing grows where I've been.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边吞，吞的是地。
lines.en: I eat as I walk. Land, mostly.

lines.zh: 我听见你在前面，声音很清楚。
lines.en: I hear you ahead. Clear.

lines.zh: 我歪歪扭扭地过来，别躲。
lines.en: I'm coming crookedly. Don't hide.

lines.zh: 这片原野的味道越来越淡。
lines.en: The field is losing its flavor.
I stand. My belly growls.

lines.zh: 我在原地生根，长出一层皮。
lines.en: Roots take hold. Another skin grows.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴，什么也没有。
lines.en: I lick my lips. Nothing there.

lines.zh: 褐色的东西从我脚下往外爬。
lines.en: Brown creeps out from under my feet.
I starve quietly. Waiting.

lines.zh: 我嘴里那口牙，是饥饿之牙。
lines.en: The teeth in my mouth are Fangs of Hunger.

lines.zh: 这地方的土是甜的，很少见。
lines.en: The soil here is sweet. Rare.
I lift a hand and watch it dry.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬到我的肚子里，随它。
lines.en: Bugs crawl into my belly. Let them.

lines.zh: 我什么也没吃，已经很久了。
lines.en: I've eaten nothing for a long while.
Wind blows dead grass to my feet.
I stand like rotted wood.

lines.zh: 原野在慢慢变成我的颜色。
lines.en: The field is taking my color.
Listening to roots grow underground.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛不常动，但都看得见。
lines.en: My eyes seldom move. They see anyway.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野里，我是长出来的那个。
lines.en: In the Starved Field, I'm what grew.

lines.zh: 我吞了一口空气，不解饿。
lines.en: I swallow air. It doesn't help.

lines.zh: 我自己也是一块腐烂的东西。
lines.en: I'm a rotting thing myself.
You stand there. Like meat.

lines.zh: 我这样看你，你不舒服吧。
lines.en: Me looking like this. Uncomfortable?

lines.zh: 你身上有温度，我很久没有。
lines.en: Heat on you. I haven't had any in a while.
I tilt my head. Drool runs down.

lines.zh: 你在往后退，但地面会抓住你。
lines.en: You're stepping back. The ground will hold you.
My eyes aren't many. Enough.

lines.zh: 你在我面前，我却不急着动。
lines.en: You're before me and I don't hurry.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，你身上是活的。
lines.en: I smell it. You're alive.
You raised a weapon. Fine.
Let's see who moves first.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的东西也在看你。
lines.en: What's in my belly is watching you too.
Don't step on my roots.
I lost a piece. I can still walk.

lines.zh: 你打进来，陷在我身上了。
lines.en: Your blow sank into me.
Pain doesn't scare me. Hunger does.

lines.zh: 身上多了个洞，会自己闭上。
lines.en: A hole in me. It'll close.
Two steps back. My stomach growls.
What you knocked off, I ate.
Brown water splashed you.
I wobbled. Straightened.
No one has dared touch me in a long time.
Keep hitting. I want to eat you more.
Food. I see food.
I eat anything. Dirt included.
Not fresh. I'll take it anyway.
One step forward. Let me smell.
Leave it and go. I'll remember.
That won't plug the hole.
Step back. I might take the hand.

lines.zh: 原野上没别的了，只剩你给的。
lines.en: Nothing else in the field. Just this.
Done swallowing. I want more.
Something moves inside me.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，撞进了一层腐肉。
lines.en: You hit me. Into rotting flesh.
I'm sticky. Don't rub against me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚下的土陷了。
lines.en: I step back. The soil gives.

lines.zh: 草皮底下，我的根缠住了。
lines.en: Under the turf, my roots have you.
This close, I think about biting.
My belly hits you. Soft.

lines.zh: 你身上沾到了褐色的东西。
lines.en: You picked up brown stains.
I shift a little. Enough?

lines.zh: 碰一下，你就知道我的味道。
lines.en: One touch and you know my smell.
This body isn't solid inside.
Like this, I only want to eat.
I'm hollow all through.
Come close and you'd be drawn in.

lines.zh: 我没有那种想法，也没有那种构造。
lines.en: I don't have the urge. Or the parts.
Step back. My belly is moving.
All I can give you is hunger.
You shouldn't ask me that.
I can't even feed myself.

lines.zh: 原野会生出更多我这样的。
lines.en: The field will grow more like me.
I answer nothing.
I pick it up and swallow it.
Tastes of soil. Fine.
I press it into my belly.
My hands can't grip. Too slick.
One piece isn't enough. I'm hungry.
Sniff. Alive? No.
I bite. Can't chew it.
I carry it in my mouth a while.

lines.zh: 这东西在肚子里没感觉。
lines.en: No feeling in my belly from that.

lines.zh: 你掉的，我一点都不客气。
lines.en: Yours. I'm not polite about it.
Something alive. I smell it.
You moved. That's enough.
This root reaches for your ankle.
The ground you stand on is mine.

lines.zh: 我听见你，也听见你的心跳。
lines.en: I hear you. And your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这原野上，只有你还在动。
lines.en: In this field, only you still move.

lines.zh: 你别跑，跑起来味道更冲。
lines.en: Don't run. Running sharpens the smell.

lines.zh: 我锁定得很慢，但不会松。
lines.en: I lock on slowly. I don't let go.

lines.zh: 我的根已经缠到你的鞋。
lines.en: My roots found your boots.
This close. No more waiting.
One step at a time. In no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的肚子在吸，你能感觉到。
lines.en: My belly is pulling. You can feel it.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛能看得清楚，但我知道你在哪。
lines.en: My eyes are poor. I know where you are anyway.

lines.zh: 这片的草都朝我这边倒了。
lines.en: Every blade here leans my way.

lines.zh: 你踩的每一步，都踩在我身上。
lines.en: Every step you take is on me.

lines.zh: 你闻到这个味了？那是我的。
lines.en: Smell that? That's mine.
This distance is close enough.

lines.zh: 剩下的路，我一口就能吃完。
lines.en: The rest of the way, one bite.

lines.zh: 我的根在下面等你落脚。
lines.en: My roots wait below for your step.
Almost. The next moment.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，连土一起。
lines.en: I bite down. Soil and all.
Roots come up and take your legs.

lines.zh: 这一下不留伤口，留一层膜。
lines.en: No wound from that. A film instead.
I dragged you a little way.

lines.zh: 你打在我身上，陷进去了。
lines.en: You struck me. Your hand sank in.

lines.zh: 我嚼了一下，牙齿是钝的。
lines.en: I chewed. Dull teeth.

lines.zh: 我吞了一口，是空气，还有你的一部分。
lines.en: I swallowed. Air, and part of you.
That knocked a piece of me off too.
I pulled back. You struggle too much.

lines.zh: 地面把我们两个都吞了半寸。
lines.en: The ground took half an inch of us both.
I grow up out of the dead soil.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野的边缘，多了一个我。
lines.en: At the Starved Field's edge, another like me.
First, brown water seeps from the ground.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，草先枯了。
lines.en: When I appeared, the grass wilted first.

lines.zh: 我什么都不记得，只记得饿。
lines.en: I remember nothing. Only hunger.

lines.zh: 这里的地太甜，我留下来。
lines.en: Sweet soil here. I'll stay.
I crawl out of the roots.

lines.zh: 有东西在我肚子里转了一圈。
lines.en: Something turned over inside my belly.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，站在这片原野上。
lines.en: Mouth open, standing in this field.
A rot smell joins the air.

lines.zh: 我从土里抬头，肚子里有东西在动。
lines.en: I lift my head from the soil; something stirs in my belly.
This ground will remember me.

lines.zh: 火烧干了我，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Fire dries me. I curl up.
Hit the ground and spread out flat.

lines.zh: 我不下水，水会把我泡烂。
lines.en: I don't go in water. It rots me.

lines.zh: 炸散的肉又慢慢爬回来。
lines.en: The scattered flesh crawls back.
Something's in my belly now.

lines.zh: 这光让我的根全部缩了。
lines.en: That light made every root retract.
Hungrier now. Can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我全身的褐色都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning. Every brown inch of me lit.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，根还在伸。
lines.en: Falling. The roots still reach.
